title: An Icechunk store in the browser

dataset.name: A public Icechunk store (ACCESS-NRI virtualized dataset, or a small test store)

left.label: warp: rangefinder
left.note: No Icechunk reader on the warp side yet. rangefinder already reads plain Zarr, Kerchunk JSON and Kerchunk Parquet references through one store seam; Icechunk is a fourth store kind behind that seam. Plan: docs/rangefinder-icechunk.md in this repo.

right.label: cell: gridlook
right.note: gridlook reads Icechunk stores and groups via icechunk-js (v1.1, v1.3). Right panel URL to be filled once a public CORS-enabled store exists.

gap: Icechunk is a first-class source for gridlook and absent from the warp side.
bridge: icechunk-js (the same reader gridlook uses) as a fourth store kind in rangefinder's openDataset; the plan is written and the work is mostly fixtures and Zarr v3 metadata details. See docs/rangefinder-icechunk.md.
